{{Quote|Long live Azzameen Home Base!|MK-09|<ref name="XWAPrima" />}}
'''Azzameen Station''', also known as '''Azzameen Home Base''', was the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] residence of the [[Azzameen family]] and the headquarters for its [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] company, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the station hosted a number of amenities for the Azzameens and their company's employees, including a [[Flight simulator/Legends|holosimulator]] and a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] large enough to store and service several [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], including the family's twin [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300s]], ''[[Sabra]]'' and ''[[Selu]]'', and their [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. Azzameen Station's design was unique in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with its distinctive semi-circular arms flanking a tall central tower.

Shortly after the war's pivotal [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], family [[Parent/Legends|patriarch]] [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] thought it [[Time/Legends|time]] to teach his youngest [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], the family business. Assisted by his siblings throughout his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] training, Ace conducted a number of missions from Azzameen Station. During Ace's training, Tomaas, sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] cause, planned to covertly deliver a [[Black market/Legends|black-market]] supply of the healing substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the Alliance [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']] and requested his family's help. However, the delivery ended disastrously for the Azzameens, who [[Death/Legends|lost]] Tomaas and his eldest son, [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], in the ensuing [[Battle of Hospital|battle]]; the Azzameens, labeled traitors to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for their actions, were forced to flee the family's holdings, including Azzameen Home Base, which were [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|captured]] and turned over to [[Viraxo Industries]], a competing trading company allied with the Empire.

Later, the station was occupied by a [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|collection of mercenaries]] who renamed it '''Falcon's Nest''' and erected a number of [[Gun Emplacement|static defenses]] to protect the unarmed structure. After the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] interrupted a [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|meeting]] between the Alliance and the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], the Rebels requested members of the Azzameen family to [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|find the mercenary base]]. Ace, now a decorated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], and his sister, [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], tracked the mercenary [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Redhawk]]'' to Falcon's Nest. Upon arrival, the Azzameens were shocked to realize it was their old home. Acting on this information, the Alliance launched a [[Battle of Azzameen Station|mission to liberate]] the station from the mercenary group, in which Ace participated alongside his civilian siblings, Aeron and [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]]. After the destruction of the external defenses, an [[Storm Unit (team)|Alliance strike team]] captured Falcon's Nest, and Aeron thwarted the mercenaries' [[Saboteur/Legends|attempt to destroy]] the station. With the mercenaries routed, the Alliance took control of the station. As thanks for the Azzameens' continued assistance, Azzameen Station was returned to the family, who restored its original moniker.

==Description==
{{Quote|No place in the galaxy looks like our old home.|MK-09|<ref name="XWAPrima" />}}
Azzameen Station was a unique<ref name="XWAPrima" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] produced by [[VenteX Construction Yards/Legends|VenteX Construction Yards]] and suspended over a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="XWA" /> in a [[Azzameen Station system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which also fell in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="Region" /> The station was owned and operated by the [[Azzameen family]], successful [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] who often referred to the station as Azzameen Home Base. It functioned both as a home for the Azzameens and as a base of operations for their shipping company, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]].<ref name="XWA" /> In all, the station housed 120 crew members and had a passenger capacity of 325 beings.<ref name="XWA" /> Members of the Azzameen family were quite fond of their Home Base and spent much of their [[Time/Legends|time]] aboard it. Family [[Parent/Legends|patriarch]] [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen's]] youngest child, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], spent his entire life on the station prior to his employment with Twin Suns Transport Services.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

[[File:AzzameenHangar.png|thumb|left|230px|Azzameen family transports ''Selu'' and ''Sabra'' parked in Azzameen Station's hangar]]
Measuring 1.45 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], Azzameen Station's structure was largely semi-circular: A tall, steeply-sloping tower, located between the station's two flanking crescent-shaped arms, extended both dorsally and ventrally from Azzameen Station's central horizontal plane, forming a cross-like shape when facing the station's fore. The central tower structure's most prominent feature was a large [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] capable of holding the family's numerous [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] as well as various types of [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]]. The station's hangar was equipped to install various weapon payloads, [[warhead countermeasure]]s, and other [[Starship/Legends|starship]] devices on landed ships. At the hangar's mouth sat a landing platform. On the top of the tower, flanked on either side by two thin spires, sat a docking port that allowed crew members to enter the station from a docked starship. Each of the station's two arms contained various mooring points that larger craft, such as a [[modular conveyor]], could utilize to dock with the station. A tower was positioned at the end of each of the two flanking arm structures.<ref name="XWA" />

The station was protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] rated at 1920 [[SBD/Legends|SBD]] and had a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] rating of 1664 [[RU/Legends|RU]]. The station's [[Comm unit/Legends|communications systems]] allowed it to contact ships in the immediate vicinity.<ref name="XWA" /> The station itself was unarmed<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and relied on [[Gun Emplacement|static defenses]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] protection in an attack. A [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam projector]] assisted [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with landing their ships in the station's main hangar. Azzameen Station included a central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and a [[Comm Datacore|communications datacore]], which stored all communications entering and leaving the station. In addition, a [[Flight simulator/Legends|holosimulator]] was kept aboard Azzameen Home Base,<ref name="XWA" /> which Ace Azzameen frequently used to improve his piloting skills.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

As a result of the family company's longstanding feud with fellow shipping conglomerate [[Viraxo Industries]] as well as the [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following a [[Battle of Hospital|failed Azzameen supply run]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], control of the station was turned over to a [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|mercenary group]], which renamed it Falcon's Nest.<ref name="XWA" /> Under [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] ownership, the station's interior was kept unkempt,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and bombs were installed into the station's wiring to prevent it from changing hands again. These bombs could be dismantled by someone with knowledge of the station's systems.<ref name="XWA" />

==History==
===Azzameen Home Base===
{{Quote|It was a cheerful day at Azzameen Home Base.|MK-09, after the Azzameen assault on Viraxo 54|<ref name="XWAPrima" />}}
[[File:OtanaSabra-dat15210-2000-XWA.png|thumb|right|230px|The ''Otana'' and one of the family's YT-1300 freighters leave Azzameen Station.]]
Built by VenteX Construction Yards,<ref name="XWA" /> Azzameen Station entered the Azzameen family's possession sometime significantly prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Dating">The events of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' begin shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' states that [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] lived [[Gender/Legends|his]] entire life aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]]. As Ace is old enough to enlist in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the Azzameens must have owned the station long enough for Ace to reach an appropriate enlistment age.</ref> The space station was placed into orbit over a volcanic planet, located in a [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the Garis [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="Atlas" /> The Azzameens&mdash;family patriarch Tomaas and his four children, [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], and Ace&mdash;used Azzameen Station as their home, earning the orbital station the moniker Azzameen Home Base, as well as the headquarters for the family's successful trading company, Twin Suns Transport Services. The Azzameens stored and serviced their two [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], the ''[[Selu]]'' and the ''[[Sabra]]'', as well as the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', in the station's main hangar.<ref name="XWA" /> These duties as well as general upkeep and cleaning often fell to the family's [[MK-series maintenance droid|maintenance droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], known as Emkay. Some of the Azzameens used the station as a permanent residence. Ace, the youngest of Tomaas's four children, had lived his entire life aboard Azzameen Station prior to his employment with Twin Suns Transport Services.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The family often used the station as a rally point for deliveries, ferrying cargo to and from their home base.<ref name="XWA" />

After narrowly escaping from the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="XWA" /> in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] at the outbreak of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>&mdash;a pivotal engagement in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic&mdash;Tomaas used Azzameen Station to repair the ''Otana'', which had sustained some damage while fleeing the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], as his [[Gender/Legends|brother]], [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]], had denied the ship access to Twin Suns Transport Service's repair facility, [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]]. Shortly after his escape from Hoth, Tomaas decided it was time for his youngest son to learn the family trade. Azzameen Station served as the staging ground for a multitude of training missions for Ace, including a delivery to the [[XQ1 Platform]] [[Harlequin Station]] and a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat exercise]].<ref name="XWA" />

During Ace's training, his sister, Aeron, accidentally deleted records for three of the family's [[Azzameen cargo fields|cargo storage areas]] and had to rebuild them by inspecting the containers manually. She and Ace departed Azzameen Station to perform the inspection, eventually discovering a container filled with illicit [[Spice/Legends|spice]] left by Viraxo Industries, a rival shipping company, in order to frame the Azzameen family. Aeron retrieved the contraband and brought it back to Azzameen Station. Using the container of spice, Antan devised a plan of retribution against the Viraxo for their continued meddling in Azzameen affairs. He dispatched Ace, Aeron, and Emon to the Viraxo [[Cargo Facility 1|cargo facility]] [[Viraxo 54]] to [[Raid on Viraxo 54|instigate a feud]] between the Viraxo and their Imperial allies. Antan's mission was not fully completed and cost the family the ''Selu'',<ref name="XWA" /> though the Azzameens managed to escape back to Azzameen Home Base and considered the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] a success.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

===A family dispersed===
{{Quote|Our involvement with the Rebellion has cost us dearly. The Empire has declared the Azzameen family to be traitors and issued warrants for our arrest. Imperial authorities have ordered the forfeiture of all Azzameen family assets. Before the Empire can seize everything, we will try to save what we can.|MK-09 shares grim news with Ace|audio=HomeBaseEmkay.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
A later mission, led by Tomaas, to supply the Rebel [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']] with a [[Black market/Legends|black-market]] supply of the healing substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] also failed. During the cargo transfer, an Imperial [[Corrupter Task Force|task force]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]] arrived and engaged the Alliance and Azzameen forces present at the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]]. The resulting battle proved disastrous for the Azzameens, as the family lost its [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], ''[[Vasudra]]''. Tomaas and Galin, who were aboard the ship, were presumed to have [[Death/Legends|perished]]. The surviving Azzameens involved in the battle, Ace and Emon, escaped the system and returned to Azzameen Home Base with the news of the family's apparent loss.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:ZG-S-XWA-Cutscene.jpg|thumb|left|230px|A squad of spacetroopers enters the booby-trapped hangar.]]
Shortly after the battle at ''Hospital'', the Empire issued warrants for the arrests of Azzameen family members<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and the [[Imperialization/Legends|seizure]] of all Azzameen assets due to the family's ties to the Rebellion as well as its multiple altercations with the Imperial-aligned Viraxo Industries, including the mission at Viraxo 54. Antan Azzameen, now the chief officer of Twin Suns Transport Services,<ref name="XWA" /> ordered both Azzameen Station and Twin Suns Station evacuated.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Antan also instructed Ace and Aeron to fetch a container of [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] and the contents of the family safe aboard the emptying Twin Suns Station, while he and Emon left Azzameen Station to retrieve supplies from one of the family's storage yards. The family parted ways at Azzameen Station, intending to regroup there before leaving for a safe place that Antan had arranged.<ref name="XWA" />

While Ace and Aeron were able to successfully collect the materials and return to the rally point at the evacuated family base, Antan was captured by the Viraxo.<ref name="XWA" /> Emon escaped and made his way back to Azzameen Station, where he relayed the news.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The trio argued the best option to take&mdash;as Antan never revealed the location to where he had planned to escape&mdash;while opportunistic Viraxo ships arrived near Azzameen Station, intending to capture the station themselves. Though the family managed to keep Azzameen Home Base secure from the Viraxo starfighters, the entry of Admiral Holtz aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']] forced the Azzameens to finally abandon the system and seek asylum with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="XWA" />

After the Azzameens' flight, a boarding party of Imperial [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s approached the station's hangar, where they fell prey to the Azzameen family's final stand: The hangar, rigged with explosives, detonated upon their entry. Despite the [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]], the station itself was largely unscathed and fell under Imperial control nonetheless.<ref name="XWA" /> Upon their capture of Azzameen Station, the Empire deemed it and its sector off-limits to civilian traffic<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and gave provisional control of Azzameen Station as well as the Azzameen's other facilities to Viraxo Industries. During Azzameen Station's occupation, the family's communications [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] was removed from the station and sent to [[Junkyard Control]], though a later [[Mission to recover Comm Datacore|Azzameen mission]] recovered it for the data stored within.<ref name="XWA" />

===Falcon's Nest===
{{Quote|Okay, we're here. There's the ''Redhawk''&hellip; and there's&hellip; our home. This can't be right&hellip; Emkay?''"<br />"''I've double-checked the coordinates, there is no doubt.''"<br />"''Our home has become a base for mercenaries?!|Aeron and MK-09, shocked at the fate of their former home|audio=R060254-58.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Sometime between the Imperial capture of Azzameen Station in 3 ABY<ref name="Dating2">The events of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' involving the capture of Azzameen Station take place after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] but before the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]]. This [[Time/Legends|time]] period corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a collection of mercenaries took control of the former Azzameen home and renamed it Falcon's Nest. To protect the station, the mercenaries erected a number of static defense platforms around Falcon's Nest and employed a starfighter complement of [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class]] and [[IRD starfighter]]s. The mercenaries also hardwired a number of explosive devices into the station's wiring. These bombs were set to detonate if Falcon's Nest changed ownership again and could only be deactivated by someone with existing knowledge of the station's onboard systems. The [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Redhawk]]'', under the mercenaries' employ, occasionally visited the space station, as would Antan Azzameen, who had been [[Rescue of Antan Azzameen|rescued]] from his earlier Viraxo capture by the surviving Azzameens. Without the knowledge of the rest of his family&mdash;with whom he had been conducting missions since his escape&mdash;Antan made contact with Falcon's Nest in an attempt to restore Twin Suns Transport Services to its former standing by cooperating with the mercenaries and their Imperial connections. During these proceedings, Antan docked his ship, the [[Action IV transport]] ''[[Big Score]]'', with Falcon's Nest.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:AzzameenStationIntro.png|thumb|right|230px|Mercenaries renamed their newly acquired space station Falcon's Nest.]]
The Imperials had noticed an opportunity to sow distrust within the Rebel Alliance based on damage caused by the [[Hurrim]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that betrayed a brief alliance with the Rebellion. The Empire contacted the mercenaries at Falcon's Nest shortly after the destruction of the Hurrim and instructed them to interrupt a [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|key meeting]] between the Alliance and a contact from the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], an intelligence agency operated by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] with key information that the Alliance needed. Though the mission's main focus was the capture of [[Borsk Fey'lya]], leader of the Bothan Spynet, the Imperials were more focused on the mission's potential to strain relations between two [[Species/Legends|species]] whose contributions to the Rebel Alliance were crucial: the Bothans and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], the latter being the supposed employers of the mercenary group. The mercenaries failed to capture Fey'lya. However, the Alliance managed to apprehend [[Unidentified mercenary (Falcon's Nest mercenaries)|one of the mercenary operatives]], who claimed to be working for the Sullustans, thereby creating the desired tension as the Empire instructed.<ref name="XWA" />

The Alliance, frustrated with the constant involvement of mercenary groups in its affairs but unable to allocate the necessary resources into finding their base of operations, requested Ace, now a decorated [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Alliance pilot]]; Aeron; and MK-09 to locate the base in an [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|unofficially-sanctioned mission]]. The Alliance gave the Azzameen duo, flying together in the family's ''Otana'', the coordinates to the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} last known location, gathered from the captured operative, who claimed that the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] contained the location of the mercenary base known as Falcon's Nest in its [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. The Azzameens successfully intercepted the ''Redhawk'' at the cargo platform ''[[Cargo Station]]'' and downloaded the suspected coordinates before heading off to what they expected to be the mercenary base. However, the coordinates had been falsified and led the Azzameens instead to a weapons testing range in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]. Soon after the departure of the Azzameens' ship, the ''Redhawk'' departed for the correct location of Falcon's Nest.<ref name="XWA" />

After narrowly avoiding the live fire of five [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] located in the Carida system, the ''Otana'' returned to ''Cargo Station'' to find that the bulk cruiser had left. Figuring that the ''Redhawk'' would have returned to the mercenary base, the Azzameens [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] through ''Cargo Station''{{'s}} departure records and discovered the location of the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} flight. The ''Otana'' followed the trail and emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] just out of range of Falcon's Nest&mdash;which the Azzameens immediately recognized as their former home.<ref name="XWA" /> After processing the shock of seeing their home converted to a mercenary base and verifying the station's identity with a quick scan,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> the Azzameens left as the mercenaries of Falcon's Nest began to scramble their defense force. When the ''Otana'' returned to the Alliance Fleet, Ace and Aeron reported their findings.<ref name="XWA" />

===Azzameen Station once more===
{{Quote|Let's go, Azzameens! Homeward bound.''"<br />"''Cut the dramatics, Emon, and stick with us, okay?|Emon and Aeron, en route to recapture their old home|audio=HomeBaseEmonAeron-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
The Alliance was determined to [[Battle of Azzameen Station|strike back]] at the mercenaries and cease their operations after receiving the data on Falcon's Nest. Due to the Azzameens' familiarity with the station, they were asked to join the Rebel strike force, though Ace was the only Azzameen enlisted. The civilian Azzameens agreed, offering their own ships in the battle.<ref name="XWA" /> Ace joined them, flying for the Alliance in a brand new [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The strike force, consisting of a group of B-wings; a group of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]; Emon's [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class starship]], ''[[Andrasta]]''; the ''Otana''; and the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] [[Storm Unit (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|''Storm Unit'']], departed from the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] and began the assault on Falcon's Nest after a brief trip through hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:AceHomeBase-dat15210-45-XWA.png|thumb|left|230px|The liberation of Azzameen Station]]
The mercenary Preybird and IRD starfighters as well as the present ''Redhawk'' moved to engage the approaching Rebellion forces. As the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] intercepted the mercenary ships, the B-wings targeted the station's static defenses in order to clear a path for ''Storm Unit''{{'s}} approach. As they engaged enemy forces, Aeron and Emon noted the presence of their uncle Antan's ''Big Score'' docked at the mercenary base. Antan, seeing the upcoming battle, fled the system without replying to any of his relatives' inquiries. The Azzameens were unable to pursue their uncle due to their mission, though Aeron assured her brothers that she would be contacting him after the battle was over.<ref name="XWA" /> Ace destroyed the gun emplacements,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and the B-wing group [[Ion cannon/Legends|disabled]] Falcon's Nest, allowing ''Storm Unit'' to begin its approach. As ''Storm Unit'' entered the system and moved to Falcon's Nest, the mercenary group's [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Plague]]'' and another group of IRD starfighters arrived and began attacking the assault transport. Ace piloted his B-wing to intercept the incoming starfighters and destroyed them, allowing ''Storm Unit'' to land in the hangar of Falcon's Nest.<ref name="XWA" /> As a [[Storm Unit (team)|team]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance commandos]] disembarked from the assault transport and fought its way through the station, the Alliance strike force destroyed the ''Redhawk'', the ''Plague'', and the rest of the mercenary starfighters.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

The [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] took control of the station soon after. The capture triggered a countdown to the destruction of Falcon's Nest due to the mercenary group's efforts to keep the station from falling out of its possession, which the commando team reported to the rest of the Alliance strike force. Aeron piloted the ''Otana'' to a dorsal access port and docked her YT-2000 [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] there just as a group of [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s entered the system and began attacking the docked [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. As Aeron moved swiftly to the commando team to assist in disarming the explosives in Falcon's Nest's wiring, the Rebel starfighters engaged and dispatched the oncoming Skipray Blastboats, giving Aeron the time needed to reach the commandos.<ref name="XWA" /> Due to her knowledge of the space station's internal systems, Aeron managed to stop the station's destruction with merely [[Standard second|seconds]] remaining.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> With the mercenary force defeated and the station in Alliance hands, the group returned to the ''Liberty''. As a way of saying thanks for the family's continued service, including its actions against the mercenary base, the Alliance gave control of the freshly liberated station back to the Azzameens.<ref name="XWA" />

Returned to its former moniker,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Azzameen Home Base served as a meeting place for the Azzameens as signs of mercenary occupation were removed from the station. Eventually, Antan called a family meeting with Emon, Aeron, and Ace to discuss his reasons for appearing at the station during the Alliance's assault. After a tense argument, Antan revealed that he was working with the mercenaries to secure the freedom of Tomaas and Galin&mdash;whom Antan claimed had not perished in the ''Vasudra''{{'s}} destruction and instead were being held at [[Kessel Station]], a maximum-security [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] orbiting [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]&mdash;even though working for the mercenaries, and thus the Empire, meant working against the Rebel Alliance. Using the knowledge of the pair's supposed location, Antan pitched a [[Mission to Kessel Station|rescue attempt]]; though reluctant, Tomaas's children agreed that family was most important, and, at Antan's insistence, the group left Azzameen Station and made its way to the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]. However, once there, they found that Antan's claim was a lie and that he had led them into an Imperial trap. The Azzameen children barely managed to escape Antan's treachery with the help of family friend [[Dunari]] and fled to the sanctuary of the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]].<ref name="XWA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|In the name of the Empire, the personnel on this station and all ships in the area are under arrest. Cease your flight, and return to the platform at once or be destroyed.|The Imperialization of Azzameen Home Base|audio=HomeBaseImp-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:AzzCapture.png|thumb|right|230px|The Imperial Star Destroyer ''Corrupter'' approaches Azzameen Station.]]
Azzameen Station primarily served as a home for the Azzameen family, comprising Tomaas Azzameen and his four children: Galin, Emon, Aeron, and Ace, as well as Tomaas's brother, Antan. The family's MK-series [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]], MK-09, known as Emkay, lived with the Azzameens aboard the station as well.<ref name="XWA" /> Acting as the station's caretaker, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] formed a close bond with the youngest of Tomaas's children, Ace, and spent enough time with the Azzameens that he considered himself a part of their family.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Due to its use as the family's home, the station was often referred to as Azzameen Home Base. The Azzameens' residence was also used as the headquarters for the family's trading company, Twin Suns Transport Services, and housed 120 crewmembers with a capacity of over 300 passengers.<ref name="XWA" />

When arrest warrants for the Azzameens were issued, they left their home as the Empire descended upon it and their trading facility. The Empire turned over the abandoned and captured station to the Viraxo. Sometime later, the station ended up in the possession of a mercenary group that renamed it Falcon's Nest. These mercenaries used the former Azzameen Station as their base, striking out from it while conducting a mission for the Empire against the Rebel Alliance. Their actions spurred a counterattack against the mercenaries, who were eventually driven out of their base by a joint Alliance and Azzameen assault. Once the space station was liberated, the Alliance gave it back to the Azzameen family,<ref name="XWA" /> who returned it to its former name.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Hope you've gotten comfortable living away from home, Ace. There's no reason to ever come back here again.|Aeron Azzameen laments a non-canonical mission failure, such as the destruction of Azzameen Station, during the station's liberation|audio=HomeBaseAeron-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Azzameen Station appeared in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'',<ref name="XWA" /> released in [[February 28]] [[1999]].<ref name="This Week! Ep5">{{ThisWeek|aXaqpI-IARE|Star Wars: The High Republic Debuts, The Magic Behind The Mandalorian, and More!|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-high-republic-debuts-the-magic-behind-the-mandalorian-and-more}}</ref> The station serves a twofold purpose in acting as a menu for players to access parts of the game as well as featuring in missions as a setting and goal.<ref name="XWA" /> Aside from the game's accompanying [[Prima]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]],<ref name="XWAPrima" /> the station would not be referenced again until the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online companion]] to<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''<ref name="Atlas" /> established Azzameen Station's location in the Garis sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

In each mission in which Azzameen Station appears, the player can attack the station. While most missions restrict the player from outright destroying it, some missions, including the station's liberation, allow the destruction of Azzameen Station.<ref name="XWA" />
